description: Open Repair Data is a compiled release of repair-event records from the Open Repair Alliance. Its repository README says the collection held 305,649 powered-item records as of its October 2025 update, covered through July 2025, and used Open Repair Data Standard version 0.3. Users can obtain the published files and analyse product type, fault and repair outcomes where fields are available. Geographic coverage follows participating community repair organisations, not every country. The README states CC BY-SA 4.0 terms. A limitation is that volunteer repair events are a selected sample of broken items and do not directly estimate population-wide failure rates or future spare-part demand. The records can help parameterise appliance life-extension, waste-service and material-flow scenarios. The related Brightway catalogue platform can model material impacts but does not publish this repair dataset. No archive or record-level data was downloaded.
name: Open Repair Alliance repair records
